candidate_build.package_role: research test snapshot; not an official competition release

validation.static_alias_role: Same-byte internal static-check alias, not a competition release.

offline_budget.limitation: Existing original true-position trace only; optimistic short loop erasure without onboard known-segment certification. Not candidate routes, not proof of communication or collision-free joins. Actual local A/B may be closer than this root-only estimate.

limitations: One seed, one new Map09 round, historical baseline; not a statistical improvement claim.
Red-side 80-point subtotal only; blue-side 20 points unmeasured.
Wall-clock is load-sensitive; unchanged source does not imply unchanged placement timing.

current_implementation_gaps: Only the common root has all-team agreement. Local group membership and local meeting markers were not jointly committed; overlapping stale group views exist.
All four navigation missions aborted on repeated current-grid segment rejection and no usable grid-route join; historical traversal did not ensure current admissibility.
The early 80px root proposal is near the initial group area and is not a verified first-split junction. Most local markers fell back toward early trail regions.
Late drone1 had insufficient return budget and only prepared a passive payload; no actual new protocol delivery of it occurred.
diagnosis.confirmed: Shared root and 0-to-4 actual payloads succeeded; full rendezvous, full stock propagation, best-map election and early submission did not occur.
diagnosis.unconfirmed: Exact cause of drone1 420-step delay and map-score increase not causally isolated. Current-grid abort does not prove a physical return route is absent.

recommendation: Do not promote as an accelerated replacement. Single-run score rose, but coordination objective failed and last bomb/submission delayed.
